q: The 'Purchase' suspense head is mainly operated to record which of the following?

options.A: Cost of stores purchased where bills await final adjustment

options.A: Recording them in the monthly review memo only

options.B: Only at the time of audit

options.B: Written back under the sanction of the competent authority

options.C: The verified and passed bill or adjustment memo

options.A: Cost of stores received pending bill verification

options.A: When stores are received but the bill is awaited or under verification

options.D: Reviewed specially and written back if found non-adjustable

q: Which statement about suspense balances is correct?

options.A: They must be cleared as soon as adjustment becomes possible
options.C: They are cleared only at audit time

q: Suspense heads in railway accounts are best described as which of the following?

options.B: They temporarily hold items pending final adjustment

q: A debit remains unadjusted in Purchase suspense in which situation?

options.A: When the bill has been fully paid and settled

options.A: By the name of the supplier

options.A: Reversing the suspense debit to the proper head

options.A: Only at the end of five years

q: What is the ideal closing balance under the Purchase suspense head?

options.C: Equal to the stock in hand

options.C: Wherever stores purchases are accounted for

options.A: They are pursued with the supplier or depot until bills arrive
